**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 14, read with 13.2 and 15.1, satisfies the IP rule's **preferred** position:

- **14.1** — Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right. Reinforced by **15.1** (no sale, advertising use, data combination or model training without consent).
- **14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor plus flow-down assignments from personnel and further-assurances.
- **14.3** — Vendor retains Vendor Technology (acceptable), but embedded/required Vendor Technology carries the **13.2** perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works, with contractor support rights.
- **14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback is voluntary and Customer retains unrestricted rights in its own feedback.

No walk-away triggers appear anywhere in the document (searches for assignment to Vendor, Vendor ownership, and joint ownership returned nothing adverse). Only immaterial note: 13.2 grants contractor-support rights rather than an express sublicence, which does not matter given outright Customer ownership of Deliverables.
